description: Returns the typical valuation multiples for small businesses in Israel by industry: the SDE (owner profit) multiple range and the revenue multiple range. Use this for general questions about how businesses in an Israeli industry are priced, with no specific business figures, such as "at what multiple do restaurants sell in Israel", "מה המכפיל של מסעדה", "כמה שנות רווח משלמים על עסק", or to explain where a valuation came from. For the value of one specific business, estimate_business_value takes its revenue and profit.

industry.description: Optional. Hebrew industry name or English alias (restaurant, retail, clinic, services, tech, construction, beauty, education, logistics, events). Omit to get all industries.

name: get_industry_multiples
